description.html: Length 35 cm, width 20 cm and height 25 cm: 700 cm² of floor and 17.5 liters. The model is elongated and shallow, with a mesh vent for ventilation and a 3D background on the back. It fits on a shelf or the edge of a desk. The outer sides get a film in the pattern you choose.

Over 35 cm of length, the heat mat goes under one third of the floor and the rest stays cooler, which is a sufficient range for a juvenile leopard gecko. A juvenile corn snake keeps to the edges and the background. Young crested, gargoyle and day geckos can start here, but they will soon need a taller terrarium. Smaller lizards use the relief of the background as a lookout.

The 35x25x20 model has the same volume with a wider floor and less height, which suits ground species better. If you are between two sizes, we will build a third to your wishes. We ship the finished terrarium by courier. The lead time for such a build is 7 to 14 days, and the outer film is chosen from 34 patterns.
